svg.title: Software architecture decision tree
svg.desc: Start: are your requirements uncertain? Yes leads to Vertical Slice Architecture. No: do you have multiple domains? No: do you have many teams? If not, is the team experienced? Yes leads to Vertical Slice Architecture, no leads to Clean Architecture. Multiple domains or many teams: do you need independent deployments? No: do you need independent scalability? No leads to Modular Monolith. Independent deployments or scalability: do you have DevOps maturity? Yes leads to Microservices, no leads to Modular Monolith. Vertical Slice, Clean and Modular Monolith are all monolithic architectures.
